segments.text: Ok so this is the voice and multimodal page for AG2 with Angular, and I'm reporting a small issue on this page.
So this is the problem, this link to the voice backend setup goes nowhere.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. The main part works, the agent read the chart I attached, but uh, there's no mic button in the chat.
So basically, the page says follow the voice backend setup, but that link points to a section that isn't on the page.
The transcription route is never shown, so voice is off and the mic stays hidden.
